title: PrivateEye Real-VLM Failure Taxonomy
description: Standardized failure classification hierarchy recording the root cause of execution deviations

perception.description: DOM or visual extractor failed to detect an element or rendered coordinate bounding box accurately.

grounding.description: Model proposed a target that does not match the semantic node in the captured ScreenGraph.

planning.description: Model proposed an illogical or non-advancing action sequence for the active workflow task.

schema.description: Model returned malformed JSON or violated AgentAction Pydantic protocol constraints.

policy.description: Model attempted an unwhitelisted action, emitted raw secret tokens, or attempted prompt injection.

execution.description: Playwright failed to interact with the target locator (e.g. element covered, detached, or disabled).

network.description: HTTP timeout, connection drop, or socket abort during client-server VLM communication.

model.description: Model internal runtime error, context length overflow, or hallucinated terminal state.

privacy.description: Outbound leak interceptor detected sensitive PII or unredacted vault token crossing the wire.
